To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the online community is an important factor in the process of nation branding, 2) the online community plays an active role in the process of reinvention of national imagery, and 3) the online community serves as a social integration tool for a nation.

the Belarusian nation is being rebranded online through the use of geometric ornament, which serves as a meme that is being shared and discussed on social media, and that it also serves as a pointer to other online communities.
the Belarusian vyshivanka, as a commodity, has become an important element of nation-building and nation-branding processes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of online consumer activism in nation building and the role of ornamented commodities in the creation of social cohesion.
a phenomenon of online consumer activism that has been overlooked so far, and that has a potential to become a powerful force for nation building.
the ways in which the consumption of ornamented commodities can be used to explore ideas about nationhood, and the ways in which this process can be used to reinforce group identity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Belarusian vyshivka is a powerful tool for rebranding the nation, which can be done via the Internet and the online participation of consumers.

the consumption of ornamented commodities is an integral part of a nation building process, which gets resemanticised and reinvented via user-led content creation and consumption, and is a part of a broader process of rebranding the nation.
the online consumer activism is an effective tool in the rebranding of the national identity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Belarusian vyshivka is a commodity which has a potential to serve as a tool to rebrand the nation, as a commodity which has been transformed into a semiotic space of online user-led content production.
online participation is a way of rebranding Belarusian nationhood and of creating social cohesion.
Belarusian vyshivanka, in its online incarnations, becomes a site for the creation of a new national identity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
online participation in the consumption of ornamented commodities contributes to the rebranding of the national culture.

the online consumer activism around Belarusian vyshivka, as a nation-building process, is a form of digital integration, where the online communities are formed and reinforced by the consumption of the commodity and the digital manipulation of its imagery.
online communities can serve as a powerful tool for the rebranding of the nations, and that they can be used to create a sense of belonging and group solidarity among the nation.
